differences.title: 1. CONNECTION TYPE
differences.leftDesc: Establishes direct connections between browsers (peers) for low-latency data transfer, bypassing central servers after initial signaling.
differences.rightDesc: Maintains a persistent, full-duplex communication channel between a client and a single server over a single TCP connection.

differences.title: 2. USE CASE FOCUS
differences.leftDesc: Optimized for streaming audio and video, enabling video conferencing, live streaming, and collaborative editing with minimal latency.
differences.rightDesc: Ideal for chat applications, live notifications, collaborative document editing, and real-time game state synchronization.

differences.title: 3. PROTOCOL MECHANISM
differences.leftDesc: Leverages UDP for media streams (SRTP) for speed, and TCP for control (data channels) and signaling.
differences.rightDesc: Operates over a single TCP connection, ensuring reliable, ordered delivery of messages with built-in flow control.

differences.title: 4. SETUP COMPLEXITY
differences.leftDesc: Requires a separate signaling server to exchange network information (SDP, ICE) before direct peer connection is established.
differences.rightDesc: Simpler initial handshake through an HTTP upgrade request; connection management is server-centric.

differences.title: 5. BANDWIDTH MANAGEMENT
differences.leftDesc: Employs STUN/TURN servers and ICE to negotiate direct paths, often overcoming NAT and firewall challenges efficiently.
differences.rightDesc: Relies on server's capacity to handle and relay all client communications; scalability depends on server infrastructure.

differences.title: 6. RELIABILITY GUARANTEE
differences.leftDesc: UDP-based media streams prioritize speed over guaranteed delivery; data channels offer SCTP for reliability.
differences.rightDesc: Built-in reliability through TCP ensures messages arrive in order without loss; less suitable for high-packet-loss scenarios.

differences.title: 7. SCALABILITY MODEL
differences.leftDesc: Scales by increasing the number of direct peer connections, reducing server load significantly for media-heavy applications.
differences.rightDesc: Scales by fortifying server infrastructure and utilizing load balancing to manage concurrent connections and message routing.
